Subject: Support Ops: procurement shortlist & pilot sequencing

Team — attaching the consolidated RFP responses and my initial scoring. We heard back from Zendesk, Intercom and Gainsight plus a small consultancy (Helix) with a proposed quick-win for inbox routing automation.

TL;DR recommendation request: which vendor(s) should we run short pilots with, and in what order? My constraints: CS needs an inbox + automation fix ASAP (Q4), Platform can spare ~2 engineer-weeks for pilot integrations, and Finance requires PO/terms before any paid pilot beyond 30 days. 

Attachments: RFP-responses.xlsx, scoring-sheet.csv, pilot-scope.md (high level scope for 30-day pilots).

Asks: 1) Please call out your preferred pilot sequencing (1,2,3) with a one-line rationale. 2) Confirm any legal/procurement blockers you know of (SaaS terms, data residency). 3) Assign an owner for the Intercom pilot scoping (we'll need Eng + CS).

I'll collate by Wed EOD and then loop in procurement/legal.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Support Ops: procurement shortlist & pilot sequencing

Rachel — quick take from a PLG/sales lens:

1) Intercom first (30-day pilot) — best for improving self-serve funnels and bot-handled cases; biggest near-term impact on CS load.
2) Zendesk parallel pilot for ticket routing and SLA visibility — they offered a lightweight pilot that doesn't require long-term commitment.
3) Gainsight after we have renewal signals and a clear events schema — their strength is renewal/health tooling, not inbox routing.

Resource ask: Dev Patel and I can scope the Intercom integration. We should reserve 2 eng-weeks and 1 CS analyst for the pilot period. Legal: check if Zendesk's pilot has any auto-conversion clauses.

Happy to lead the Intercom pilot scoping if that helps.

—Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Zendesk pilot proposal for Redwood Inference

Hi Rachel — thanks for the RFP and the call yesterday. Attached is a short pilot proposal (zendesk-pilot-proposal.pdf) covering: scope (ticket routing, SLA dashboards, automations), success criteria, and a 30-day pilot price (waived for proof-of-concept; paid only if conversion to production).

Key notes:
- Pilot includes a Zendesk technical lead for configuration and a 2-week enablement session for CS ops.
- No auto-renewal; any production contract is a separate procurement step.
- We can provide sandbox access and sample connectors for event ingestion.

If helpful I can set a 30-minute walkthrough with our solutions architect next week.

Best,

Approved — proceed with pilot sequencing as follows:

1) Intercom pilot (priority): Aditya to own scope and PO request. Dev Patel to allocate 2 eng-weeks. Marcus to define success metrics with CS analysts.
2) Zendesk pilot (parallel): Accept Zendesk's 30-day pilot terms; Rachel to finalize kickoff and schedule their solutions architect. Procurement/legal (cc Laura Bennett) to review the pilot doc and confirm no auto-convert clauses.
3) Gainsight: exploratory only for now — ask Gainsight for a POC quote and minimum requirements. If they can do a 30-day proof for renewal signals, we will evaluate post-pilot.

Finance: Laura, please open a PO placeholder for the pilots (we'll route actual costs after sign-off). Rachel — once Zendesk confirms dates, loop Legal/Procurement and I'll sign-off on the PO.

Related: I've uploaded a short list of next steps (procurement-next-steps.md) and put a Drive folder at https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d-pilot-scope.
